## Summary

- **Complete V1 garage booking system** — customers can book car services \(oil change, brakes, suspension, diagnostics & more\) from their phones in under 30 seconds
- **Trust-first landing page redesign** — visitors discover value before being asked to sign in, based on marketing team feedback
- **Admin dashboard** — approve/reschedule/cancel bookings, sort by date or name, export data as CSV

- 📱 My Bookings page with full service history and status tracking

- 📊 Dashboard with booking queue, search, filter by status, sort by date/name
- ✅ Approve, reschedule, or cancel bookings with email notifications
- 📥 CSV export for all booking data
- 🔒 Access controlled by email whitelist

- Next.js 15 + React 18 + TypeScript
- Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Storage
- Resend email API with 7 branded HTML templates
- Tailwind CSS with custom brand design system
- PWA manifest + offline detection
- Dynamic OG image for social sharing
- Vercel Analytics integration
- Firestore + Storage security rules
